f-indemn-cf3eceff.reason: The redline adds express defense duties, affiliate coverage, and law, data and IP triggers, but it does not fully cover all Vendor-caused data breaches. More importantly, the new trigger language is placed after Section 9.2, while the notice and defense-control mechanics expressly concern claims under Section 6.3, leaving those mechanics inapplicable or materially ambiguous for the new indemnities. The fallback also fails because all stated exclusions, remedies and the 3× annual-fees super-cap are absent. The redline is not minimal because it reaches neither complete position and extends the new triggers beyond third-party claims. Unrelated existing commercial terms remain operative, so overall intent is preserved despite the placement and scope defects.
